raised_because.stale_fact_pages: 57 to 58 on 2026-09-09. The clock now starts at the last read that found nothing outstanding, which is the rule dateModifiedFor already applied to the date those pages publish. Six pages moved and /email-comparison-2026 joined the cohort; 338 stale facts became 346. Nothing about the catalogue changed — the measurement did.
